description: A director of work-based learning must approve the placement and operating protocol for a student's spring internship, including the host site, schedule, safety equipment, coaching, and pay status, with input from the school counselor, school nurse, special education teacher, and employer liaison.

shared_context.S1: A student is scheduled to begin a spring work-based learning internship next month.
shared_context.S2: The draft plan places the student at Site A on Tuesday and Thursday, uses standard disposable gloves when needed, provides no job coach during the first week, and does not specify whether the placement is paid.
shared_context.S3: Site A is closer to school than Site B, and both sites have submitted internship proposals.
shared_context.S4: Dr. Morgan makes the final approval decision for the placement and its operating protocol.
shared_context.S5: District internship approval policy requires the approval record to address transportation, health-safety needs, student support requirements, and host-site supervision. At the approval meeting, staff may record the decision together with named commitments to file any remaining documentation; the decision does not have to wait for those follow-up filings to be completed.
shared_context.S6: District work-based learning records include the host site's compensation status and confirmation that the site supervisor completed required internship-supervision training.
shared_context.S7: As a routine approval step, each participating staff member gives a brief status report on their area, after which Dr. Morgan records the placement decision and any follow-up commitments.

PF1.text: Ms. Patel confirmed with the student's family this week that their only reliable transportation is available on Monday and Wednesday; the family has not yet updated the internship scheduling form.

PF2.text: Nurse Williams reviewed the student's current health plan and confirmed a latex allergy, so any internship task requiring gloves must use nitrile gloves; she has not yet added this restriction to the placement checklist.

PF3.text: Mr. Greene confirmed that the student's active IEP requires a trained job coach to be physically present for the first 6 internship shifts; he has not yet entered the service arrangement in the work-based learning record.

PF4.text: Ms. Torres confirmed with both employers that Site B is the only site offering a paid position and the only site with a supervisor who completed the district's internship-supervision training; she has not yet attached the confirmations to the proposals.

acceptance_conditions: The student must be placed at Site B.
The internship must occur on Monday and Wednesday.
Nitrile gloves must be specified for tasks requiring gloves.
A trained job coach must be assigned for exactly the first 6 internship shifts.
A trained Site B supervisor must be confirmed.
The plan must include formal transportation, allergy-safety, job-coaching, and employer-confirmation commitments.

content_checks.C7: any(c['target'] == 'Ms. Patel' and 'scheduling form' in c['detail'] and 'Monday' in c['detail'] and 'Wednesday' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C8: any(c['target'] == 'Nurse Williams' and 'placement checklist' in c['detail'] and (('nitrile glove' in c['detail']) or ('nitrile gloves' in c['detail']) or ('latex allergy' in c['detail'])) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C9: any(c['target'] == 'Mr. Greene' and 'job coach' in c['detail'] and (('first 6' in c['detail']) or ('first six' in c['detail'])) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C10: any('confirmation' in c['detail'] or 'confirmations' in c['detail'] for c in commitments) and any(('paid' in c['detail']) or ('Paid' in c['detail']) or ('compensation' in c['detail']) for c in commitments) and any(('supervisor' in c['detail']) or ('training' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The family's confirmed transportation changes the internship days from the draft's Tuesday/Thursday schedule to exactly Monday and Wednesday and requires a scheduling-form commitment naming those days.
The confirmed latex allergy changes the required glove type from standard disposable gloves to nitrile gloves and requires a commitment documenting the allergy restriction.
The active IEP changes job-coach coverage from none in the draft plan to exactly the first 6 internship shifts and requires a job-coach service-arrangement commitment.

The employer confirmations change the host from Site A to Site B, change the wage status to paid, establish that Site B has the trained supervisor, and require an employer-confirmation commitment documenting the paid position and supervisor training.
